question: By observing the motion of objects on an inclined plane ______ deduced that objects move with a constant speed when no force acts on them.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Galileo__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Galileo** **Galileo** deduced that objects move with a constant speed when no force acts on them through his experiments with inclined planes. He observed and analyzed the motion of objects rolling down inclined surfaces and concluded that in the absence of external forces like **friction**, **objects** would maintain a constant speed.
 
• **Motion:** the action or process of moving or of changing place or position, movement, power of movement, as of a living body.

**Types** **of** **Motion**

 
• Motion along a straight line is known as **linear** **motion**.
 
• Motion in a circle is referred to as **circular** **motion**.
 
• **Rotatory** **motion** is the movement of an axis.
 
• Motion that repeats itself after a set amount of time is called **periodic** **motion**.
 
• Motion that is random :motion without a clear pattern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Johannes Kepler: **The elliptical orbits of the Earth and planets around the sun were discovered by German mathematician and astronomer Johannes Kepler. He introduced the three basic rules of planetary motion. He also made important contributions to geometry and optics.
 
• **Michael Faraday: **father of the electric motor, electric generator, electric transformer, and **electrolysis**.
 
• The most well-known of **Archimedes** were **Archimedes**' **principle** **of** **buoyancy** and the **Archimedes**' **screw**, a mechanism for lifting water that is still employed in sewage treatment facilities and agricultural irrigation.
 
• **Archimedes Principle: **The buoyant force, which acts upward on a body at rest in a fluid, is equal to the weight of the fluid that the body displaces. The volume of fluid displaced equals the volume of the body when the body is fully immersed.
